notes.title: Trial DEMO Update Announcement
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291820/ccdc176e0ce28f90f95c6fc6b2978c1f101681b1.jpg[/img]
Dear players, hello. In order to provide a better gaming experience, we have gradually made some adjustments to the game trial version recently

Update content
1. Cancel all slow motion shots except for some special actions to ensure smooth combat.
2. Refactor based on the default controller design of mainstream action games on the market.

tips： The player who downloaded the trial version before needs to use a new controller solution, you can open the settings page to reset the controller solution. Thank you again.

notes.title: DEMO Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291820/c900afc3a50a29618efddc73f2b297cfbd41ca51.jpg[/img]
At first, in order to enhance the visual experience of the battle, we made some bold attempts in the tuning of the camera. However, it was obvious that we played poorly, so we corrected the camera again, enhancing the openness of the field of view. At the same time, we greatly increased the priority of sprinting and dodging over martial arts, and suppressed the enemy to the end. This way, players can use sprinting or dodging to forcefully interrupt martial arts at any time and have more freedom in attack and defense transitions (but need to manage their physical strength to some extent). Thank you again for your valuable suggestions.

Optimize and adjust
1. Adjust the perspective to provide a broader perspective for battles.
2. Sprint to increase the distance response and make it attack enemies faster.
3. Prioritize teleportation evasion over martial arts, greatly enhancing the protagonist's mobility and improving combat fluency.
